name: New articles get indexed
goal: A new blog article or language edition goes live on virev.ai every day and answers 200, and Google indexes each new one within 3 days. Every miss has a live fix job pushing changes; the older unindexed backlog, IndexNow and the ledger are detail lines.

metrics.label: Days since a new blog article or edition went live and returned 200
Articles from the last 14 days still unindexed 3+ days after going live
Data sources that failed (sitemap, pages, Search Console)

onMiss: Every run works in auto-sns-agent's SEO program (apps/llm-wiki/content/sessions/2026/10/02/0040-virev-seo-agent/program), under its brief.md rules. Each missed metric gets one live fix job with a board step under p40: days_since_new_article goes to "daily articles ship", which lands and promotes the next built article or writes the next one from opportunities.md, one subagent per article, and new_unindexed_3d goes to "crawl demand fix" (p60). A live job (agent_observe.list_agents) gets the new numbers and flagged lines by message; a missing one starts with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=...), and its step's job is set to it. Never start a second copy. source_errors: fix the read this run, or start "seo sources fix". Also run `seo indexnow --new` when the detail lists unsent URLs, and score each overdue ledger check. Never end a run with a missed metric and no live fix job. Nothing goes outside (c37), and prod promotes need no ask (c74).
